NOTE
**Still not ready — the merge commit is still in the history**

New: The author pushed twice and asked @Asteriskkkk to review, but the commit messages are unchanged and the list still includes "Merge branch 'main' into fix-view-all-users-focus". Missing: a rebase onto main so the PR is one coherent commit with no merge commit.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave the PR unassigned until the history is cleaned up.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update! The history still has a "Merge branch 'main'" commit, so please rebase onto main to remove it and leave one clean commit, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Then post again to request a review.
```
